# Backlink profile review — Q3 2026

Backlink profile as of 2026-09-30: 1,980 referring domains, DR 43. The disavow file submitted in July removed the expired-domain network. The first outreach wave (Dolomites hut guides, Italian hiking blogs) produced 41 new editorial links, 12 of them to the packing guide. Next wave targets German and Dutch travel blogs in English. The gap to Cimalta narrowed to about 1,000 domains.
